abstract: Decompacting Fab were used as tools to modify cell interactions during embryoid body formation and differentiation of the embryonal carcinoma (EC) PSMB. Two kinds of Fab were used: anti-uvomorulin Fab which recognize only the adhesion glycoprotein uvomorulin and Fab from an anti-EC serum which recognizes a series of molecules including uvomorulin. Both types of Fab led to decompaction and formation of loose aggregates with abnormal deposition of extracellular matrix (ECM) components. Anti-uvomorulin Fab did not affect the pattern of embryoid body differentiation. In contrast Fab anti-EC induced a differentiation of most of the cells in the aggregate into an endoderm-like phenotype. This effect was observed only when anti-EC Fab were added to aggregates and not to monolayer cultures.
abstract_ja: 胎児性癌(EC)細胞株PSMBの胚様体形成と分化の過程で、細胞間相互作用を変化させるための道具として、脱圧縮Fab(decompacting Fab)を用いた。用いたFabは2種類で、接着糖タンパク質ウボモルリンのみを認識する抗ウボモルリンFabと、ウボモルリンを含む一連の分子を認識する抗EC血清由来のFabである。いずれのFabも脱圧縮を引き起こし、細胞外基質成分が異常に沈着したゆるい凝集塊を形成させた。抗ウボモルリンFabは胚様体の分化パターンに影響しなかった。対照的に、抗EC Fabは凝集塊内の大部分の細胞を内胚葉様の表現型へと分化させた。この作用は、Fabを単層培養に加えた場合には認められず、凝集塊に加えた場合にのみ観察された。
